findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_opportunities" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search every SAP contract and permanent-role posting Analytics Legends publishes to an ANONYMOUS visitor — the same population a human browses on /opportunities…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "find_opportunities" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_firms, list_freelance_platforms, find_opportunities, search_news, search_concepts, get_concept, list_studies, find_partner_candidates, get_firm_intel · Private data: get_firm, find_opportunities, get_concept_card, get_study, get_academy_module, find_sap_clients, get_sap_client_profile, get_expansion_brief, find_partner_candidates, get_firm_intel · Public sink: find_opportunities · Destructive: get_study, find_sap_clients.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_firms, list_freelance_platforms, find_opportunities, search_news, search_concepts, get_concept, list_studies, find_partner_candidates, get_firm_intel · Private data: get_firm, find_opportunities, get_concept_card, get_study, get_academy_module, find_sap_clients, get_sap_client_profile, get_expansion_brief, find_partner_candidates, get_firm_intel · Public sink: find_opportunities · Destructive: get_study, find_sap_clients

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
